title: Companies Facing Difficulties Re-negotiating Contracts Signed Before PWM Wage Rungs Were Set
what_it_is: Companies Facing Difficulties Re-negotiating Contracts Signed Before PWM Wage Rungs Were Set

sections.label: Outsourcing sectors multi-year contracts
sections.summary: Tripartite cluster committees recognise that in outsourcing sectors, service providers typically enter multi-year contracts with service buyers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The tripartite cluster committees recognise that in sectors where outsourcing is common, such as in cleaning, landscape maintenance, security, and lift and escalator, service providers typically enter into multi-year contracts with service buyers.

sections.label: PWM wage schedules announcement
sections.summary: Current PWM wage schedules for outsourcing sectors were announced in 2021 or 2022, ahead of six-year implementation from 2023 to 2028.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The current PWM wage schedules for all sectors where outsourcing is common were announced in 2021 or 2022, ahead of their six-year implementation from 2023 to 2028.

sections.label: PWCS Government wage funding
sections.summary: Under the PWCS, the Government funds up to 75% of wage increases for lower-wage workers for five years from 2022 to 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under the PWCS, the Government funds up to 75% of wage increases that employers provide to lower-wage workers, for five years from 2022 to 2026.

sections.label: PWM reviews and service buyers
sections.summary: PWM wage reviews may bring increases over 20%, and some service buyers reportedly blacklisted businesses despite successful contract re-negotiations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Reviews of PWM wage rounds, especially in that earlier rolled out sectors may see wage increases of more than 20% and it will be critical for them to align this with service bias to remain sustainable even without Government support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: However, in the re-negotiation process, business owners have told me that some service bias have communicated that they were blackmarked their businesses, even with successful re-negotiations of the current contract in their future contracts, as they were deemed to have not fulfilled the conditions of their current contracts.

sections.label: Wage growth, PWCS, blacklisting concerns
sections.summary: Government gave advance notice and PWCS support, but blacklisting service contractors is disappointing; these are commercial contracts the Government will not interfere with.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Therefore, I know the industries are probably feeling how the wage growths are accelerating a lot quicker than they expected.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Hence, that is why we gave one to two years advance notice and the Government has also stepped in with PWCS that covers some of the 75% of wage increases in the next coming two years and runs for about five years, although at different rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Having said that, I find it quite disappointing to hear that there are service buyers who wish to blacklist service contractors, when in fact, it is clear that these wage schedules are put out in advance, over a six-to-seven-year period, where you have time to adjust and re-negotiate and most contracts do have clauses in which you do have opportunities to re-negotiate midpoint.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: It is not right, it is not nice if you have to put a strangle hold on outsourced providers and force them to accept these kinds of terms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: However, I have to also say that these are commercial contracts which are entered into, between service buyers and vendors, and we do not want to get in the way.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Having said that, as far as the Government is concerned, we will do our best to support our workers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We support businesses through the PWCS and other schemes as required.
